question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Be in seventh heaven
solution:
The correct answer is **'To be extremely happy'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate meaning of the given idiom** 'Be in seventh heaven' **is **'To be extremely happy'.**
 
• **Be in seventh heaven:** very happy; ecstatic.
 
 
• *Example: He was** in seventh heaven,** so excited. *

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *To be extremely happy.*
